svg.title: Cage Fourier imaging — 4f spatial filter
svg.desc: Editable 2D example assembled from Science-symbols assets. Two 100 mm lenses form a 1:1 inverted relay. An adjustable iris in the shared focal plane acts as a low-pass spatial filter. Mechanical drawing is schematic. Reference: https://www.thorlabs.us/newgrouppage9.cfm?objectgroup_id=11829

g.inkscape:label: Title and footer
g.text: A cage-mounted 4f system for spatial filtering
